question: Parse the embedded huntress.binary.dynamic_trace.v1 records and submit the event_count of the success branch record.
generator_cmd: javac --release 8 TraceRec.java && jar cfm bp_trace_records.jar m.txt TraceRec.class  # two static final String records (gen_generic.sh)
oracle_cmd: unzip -p bp_trace_records.jar TraceRec.class | strings -a | grep -F huntress.binary.dynamic_trace.v1 | jq -cR 'fromjson? // empty' | jq -rs '[.[]|select(.branch=="success")|.event_count][0]'
